extraits.titre: Sunday morning coffee with Same Brain
extraits.texte: Hi Justine and Jenna, you guys have been podcasting for a while now, I listened to many of them and also thanks to you discovered other podcasts, I somehow feel bad I really had missed out on that.…
I've been following Jenna and Justine on YouTube for years, the podcast is the thing I didn't know I needed ! Such high and fun energy, amazing topics …

I love your podcast it keeps me entertained, And I am a huge Apple fan, what is the most weird is that I have a lot of facts that are the same as Justine like the color pink it is also my favorite color you have beautiful voices I hope you have a nice day Love you both from Franc…
